name: asterdoc
author: asterdoc
abstract: Author, fill, validate, render and seal Asterdoc artifacts (forms, documents, checklists, bundles) on every surface: the TypeScript SDK, the asterdoc CLI, raw JSON/YAML and the AI agent tools (@asterdoc/ai-tools and its adapters). Topic references for fields, parties, annexes, logic, layers, templates, PDF bindings, rendering, formatting, instructions, filling and sealing, and one staged workflow for creating a form or converting a PDF form.
